name: Diophantine System of Edge Types
description: Replaces the single energy equation (which trivially decomposed into a per-edge maximum, allowing models to deduce that only (1,2) edges could reach the target) with two simultaneous global sum conditions. Neither condition has its maximum at (1,2), and each condition individually allows for mixes of (1,1) and (2,2) edges. Models that rely on local bounds will fail to see the bipartite structure and will likely implement a TLE-prone general solver.
